# Contributing & Incident Reporting Guidelines

Thank you for contributing to **`userfn-git/main`**.

## Reporting Issues

1. Use the standardized forms in [New Issue](https://github.com/userfn-git/main/issues/new/choose).
2. Select the target hardware node (`FN-WORKSTATION` PC or Mobile Device).
3. Strip all hardware serial numbers, product keys, and private tokens before submitting logs.

## Pull Requests

- Ensure all PowerShell, Python, C++20, and Lua scripts execute cleanly without interactive hangs.
- Reference official documentation for any kernel API, physics solver, or SDK changes.
